<p style="font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.75; color: #374151;">
If you are interested in collaborating on memory research, statistical power simulations in R, or legal psychology projects, please feel free to reach out via email.
</p>

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
### Prospective Students &amp; Researchers
When inquiring about thesis supervision or postdoctoral collaborations, please include:
1. A brief summary of research interests and relevant experience (e.g. experimental psychology, criminology, R programming).
2. Your academic CV.
3. Any relevant writing or code samples / preprints.
:::
